name: AgriTrace Monitoring Dashboard
description: Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for AgriTrace application

widgets.title: Application Health Status
widgets.query: requests | where url contains '/api/health/' | summarize count() by resultCode | render piechart

widgets.title: Response Time Trends
widgets.query: requests | where url contains '/api/' | summarize avg(duration) by bin(timestamp, 5m) | render timechart

widgets.title: Error Rate
widgets.query: requests | where resultCode >= 400 | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 10m) | render timechart

widgets.title: Recent Application Logs
widgets.query: traces | where severityLevel >= 2 | project timestamp, message, severityLevel | order by timestamp desc | take 50

widgets.title: Container Resource Usage
widgets.query: performanceCounters | where counterName == 'Memory Available Bytes' or counterName == 'Processor Time' | summarize avg(counterValue) by counterName, bin(timestamp, 5m) | render timechart

alerts.name: High Error Rate Alert
alerts.description: Triggers when error rate exceeds 5% over 10 minutes
alerts.query: requests | where resultCode >= 400 | summarize errorRate = count() * 100.0 / toint(countif(true)) by bin(timestamp, 10m) | where errorRate > 5

alerts.name: Application Down Alert
alerts.query: requests | where url contains '/api/health/' and resultCode != 200 | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 5m) | where count_ > 0

alerts.name: High Response Time Alert
alerts.description: Triggers when average response time exceeds 2 seconds
alerts.query: requests | where url contains '/api/' | summarize avgDuration = avg(duration) by bin(timestamp, 10m) | where avgDuration > 2000
